websites.title: Websites
websites.description: List of websites to scan for contact details. Domain or full URL, with or without scheme (e.g. "apify.com" or "https://apify.com").

maxExtraPages.title: Max extra pages per site
maxExtraPages.description: How many additional same-domain pages to fetch beyond the homepage, chosen from links whose URL or text looks like contact, about, impressum, team, support or kontakt.
